title: Los Angeles: hearing Louis at Sebastian's and miniature golf
summary: On the West Coast the band heard Louis in person and ran in from the miniature golf course to catch him on the radio.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: But I heard him in person out there.
Yeah. I heard him in person.
You were out there with Duke.
And we'd be out there on that little miniature golf course, playing golf, and time for Louis to come on the air, we'd drop those clubs and run and get the radio.
No kidding. How about that. Well, was

There. Cootie, let's go back. We were talking about -- you said you'd be out on the golf course and everybody would drop the clubs and rush in because Louis was going to be on the air. And that was out in L.A., wasn't it?
Well, listen, I didn't realize that the guys were playing golf in those days.
Oh, I see. Yes, of course.
Yeah. Right. Well, who would you be playing with? Who in the band did you --
Yeah. Be out there hitting them balls.
Oh, that's good. And in those days, did the guys get out and play baseball, too? When they were on the road.
Because Fletcher's band did, I think.
Oh, well, that's good. Well, hold it a minute, now, then.
